text:
karen-csm: :rotating_light: Heads up — customer 'MaplePay' opened a P1. They see a cluster of 504s and timeouts hitting our hosted inference endpoint over the last hour. Ticket: https://support.redwood.example/t/CH-2345. Partial logs attached in the ticket. Noticed high request queue lengths on their tenant.
mira-support: Thanks Karen. I pulled their request traces — p95 jumps to ~9s and a lot of requests end with gateway 504. They started at 08:12 UTC. Minimal traffic otherwise.
ben-oncall: I'm on it. Initial look at ingress graphs shows sustained queue depth hitting the configured limit for the continuous-batcher queue for that tenant, then a sharp increase in dequeue latency. Linking graphs: https://grafana.redwood/boards/queue/MaplePay
dmitri-infra: Looks like kvcache churn for that tenant spiked right before the 504 window. Evictions increased and we started dropping batching prefixes. Could be a long-seq workload causing repeated cache misses -> larger batch formation times.
sunita-eng: Repro attempt: I replayed a representative long-seq job in the staging cluster with the same model and observed continuous-batcher forming very large speculative batches which increased tail-latency. Steps: 
```
# replay request
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"<long chat history>...", "max_tokens":3000}'
```
Observation: batch formation time jumps from ~30ms to ~1.2s under cache miss noise.
mira-support: Customer claims they didn't change prompts. They use a webhook that sends a burst of 40 parallel long conversations per minute. Might be small burst but with long sequences its backlog.
ben-oncall: Short-term mitigation applied: bumped tenant queue depth soft limit from 120 -> 180 and enabled immediate fallback routing to a lightweight model variant for requests hitting >1s queue delay. Applied at 08:45 UTC. Monitoring for 15m.
ops-bot: Action taken: tenant-queue-config-update(MaplePay) by ben-oncall at 2026-03-17T08:45:10Z.
dmitri-infra: I pushed a hotfix to continuous-batcher to cap speculative batch size per-slot (experimental). The binary roll is on 2 nodes in the pool. If this reduces formation time we can roll further.
sunita-eng: Can we get a repro plan for the customer? Mira, can you ask them for a short sample of the webhook payload and the exact request cadence (timestamps)? If they can reproduce in prod we can correlate logs.
mira-support: Asked the customer for payload and cadence. Also requested a windowed trace id. Customer replied with sample at 08:18 UTC and consent to rerun with debug=true flag.
ben-oncall: From monitoring after mitigation: queue depth fell back to ~70 within 6m, 504s dropped to zero, p95 fell to 520ms. We'll keep the routing fallback and the temporary depth bump until infra confirms patch effectiveness.
dmitri-infra: Preliminary postpatch metrics from the two nodes show batch formation 95th down from 1.2s -> 180ms. I'll coordinate full rollout and follow-up on kvcache tuning (reduce eviction threshold for tenants with long-seq patterns).
sunita-eng: For the postmortem/action items: 1) run a tenant-level kvcache profile job to identify eviction hot tenants, 2) add an automated tenant cadence detector to flag long-seq bursts and apply adaptive small-batch policy, 3) document safe queue depth bump guidance for SREs.
karen-csm: Customer update sent: "We saw errors, Redwood applied temporary fixes and are investigating root cause — will follow up with permanent mitigations." They asked about SLA credit; flagged to finance/sales.
mira-support: Next steps: wait for infra full rollout, ask customer to validate for 24h, collect traces for the 08:12 window for PMR.
ben-oncall: Tagged this incident as non-servicewide; follow-up timeline 48h. If we see recurrence we'll revert to dedicated throttling per-model and open a higher-priority fix. :thumbsup:
